body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> San Disk presented the Sansa Connect, its new WiFi enabled mp3 player during CES 2007.
The Sansa Connect lets users to connect to music, online photos or steaming internet radio without pc in any WiFi hot spot.
It features 2.2 TFT color screen, internal speaker, and micro SD card slot for additional memory capacity. It runs on lithium-ion battery.
It will ship to retail in late march with suggested retail price of 249.99(USD).
